SELECT (WITH RECURSIVE metadata AS (SELECT $4::pg_catalog.jsonb AS v),
    raw AS (SELECT x AS r FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements((SELECT COALESCE(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_array(weft_tree_node."state_id"::pg_catalog.text,weft_tree_node."node_id"::pg_catalog.text,weft_tree_node."parent_node_id"::pg_catalog.text,weft_tree_node."value_kind"::pg_catalog.text,weft_tree_node."slot_kind"::pg_catalog.text,weft_tree_node."sequence_ordinal"::pg_catalog.text,weft_tree_node."map_key"::pg_catalog.text,pg_catalog.encode(weft_tree_node."record_field_identity_bytes",'hex'),pg_catalog.encode(weft_tree_node."definition_bytes",'hex'),pg_catalog.encode(weft_tree_node."source_bytes",'hex'),weft_tree_scalar."state_id"::pg_catalog.text,weft_tree_scalar."node_id"::pg_catalog.text,weft_tree_scalar."scalar_kind"::pg_catalog.text,weft_tree_scalar."text_value"::pg_catalog.text,weft_tree_scalar."boolean_value"::pg_catalog.text,weft_tree_scalar."numeric_value"::pg_catalog.text,weft_tree_scalar."numeric_token"::pg_catalog.text,weft_tree_scalar."temporal_text"::pg_catalog.text,weft_tree_scalar."temporal_instant"::pg_catalog.text,pg_catalog.encode(weft_tree_scalar."binary_value",'hex'),pg_catalog.encode(weft_tree_scalar."opaque_bytes",'hex'),pg_catalog.encode(weft_tree_scalar."codec_definition_bytes",'hex'),pg_catalog.encode(weft_tree_scalar."original_source_bytes",'hex'))), '[]'::jsonb) FROM "pg_temp"."row_home_node" weft_tree_node FULL JOIN "pg_temp"."row_home_scalar" weft_tree_scalar ON weft_tree_node."state_id"=weft_tree_scalar."state_id" AND weft_tree_node."node_id"=weft_tree_scalar."node_id" WHERE COALESCE(weft_tree_node."state_id",weft_tree_scalar."state_id")="weft_state_0"."state_id")) x),
    walk(r,i,path,depth) AS (
      SELECT r,(metadata.v->>'root')::int,ARRAY[]::text[],0 FROM raw,metadata
      WHERE r->>2 IS NULL AND r->>4='root' AND r->>1 IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT child.r,next.i,w.path||next.key,w.depth+1
      FROM walk w CROSS JOIN metadata
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT metadata.v->'nodes'->w.i->'shape' AS shape) original
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN original.shape->>'kind'='structured'
        THEN metadata.v->'nodes'->(original.shape->>'record')::int->'shape'
        ELSE original.shape END AS shape) container
      JOIN raw child ON child.r->>2=w.r->>1 AND child.r->>0=w.r->>0
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT (container.shape->>'item')::int AS i,child.r->>5 AS key
        WHERE container.shape->>'kind'='sequence' AND w.r->>3='sequence' AND child.r->>4='sequence'
        UNION ALL SELECT (container.shape->>'item')::int,child.r->>6
        WHERE container.shape->>'kind'='map' AND w.r->>3='map' AND child.r->>4='map'
        UNION ALL SELECT (member->>'valueNode')::int,member->>'storedName'
        FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(container.shape->'members','[]'::jsonb)) member
        WHERE container.shape->>'kind'='record' AND w.r->>3 IN ('structured','record')
          AND child.r->>4='record' AND child.r->>7=member->>'identityHex'
      ) next WHERE w.depth<128
    )
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('rows',COALESCE((SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(
      pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('cells',r,'logicalNode',i,'path',path,'depth',depth) ORDER BY depth,path) FROM walk),'[]'::jsonb),
      'unmatchedRows',(SELECT count(*) FROM raw)-(SELECT count(*) FROM walk),
      'uniqueNodes',(SELECT count(*) FROM raw)=(SELECT count(DISTINCT (r->>0,r->>1)) FROM raw),
      'matchingShapes',COALESCE((SELECT bool_and(CASE metadata.v->'nodes'->i->'shape'->>'kind'
        WHEN 'scalar' THEN r->>3 IN ('scalar','null') ELSE r->>3=metadata.v->'nodes'->i->'shape'->>'kind' END) FROM walk,metadata),FALSE))
    ) AS mapping FROM "pg_temp"."object" AS "weft_scan_0" LEFT JOIN "pg_temp"."row_home_state" AS "weft_state_0" ON "weft_state_0"."owner_kind"='object' AND "weft_state_0"."object_id"="weft_scan_0"."id" AND "weft_state_0"."object_type_id"="weft_scan_0"."type_id" AND "weft_state_0"."property_owner_type_id"=$2::pg_catalog.int4 AND "weft_state_0"."property_id"=$3::pg_catalog.int4 LEFT JOIN "pg_temp"."row_home_node" AS "weft_node_0" ON "weft_node_0"."state_id"="weft_state_0"."state_id" AND "weft_node_0"."node_id"="weft_state_0"."root_node_id" LEFT JOIN "pg_temp"."row_home_scalar" AS "weft_scalar_0" ON "weft_scalar_0"."state_id"="weft_node_0"."state_id" AND "weft_scalar_0"."node_id"="weft_node_0"."node_id" WHERE ("weft_scan_0"."type_id" = $1::pg_catalog.int4)
